name: GT1 Smartwatch | Bluetooth Calling | Full Touch Display | Android & iOS Compatible
description:
Stay connected and in control with the GT1 Smartwatch, designed to combine smart features with everyday style. Featuring a 1.3-inch full-touch display, this smartwatch offers smooth navigation and a clear viewing experience. With Bluetooth calling support, you can answer calls directly from your wrist—perfect for busy days and on-the-go convenience. Built for daily life, the GT1 includes practical tools like a sedentary reminder, alarm clock, remote camera control, and wrist-raise screen activation. Its IP67 waterproof rating makes it suitable for everyday wear, whether you're at work, outdoors, or during light workouts.

Key Features:
Bluetooth Calling – Answer calls directly from your smartwatch
1.3" Full Touch Display – Smooth and easy navigation
Wrist Raise to Wake – Screen lights up with a simple hand movement
Sedentary Reminder – Encourages an active lifestyle
Remote Camera Control – Capture photos from your phone via watch
Alarm Clock Function – Stay on schedule
IP67 Waterproof – Protection from splashes and dust
Android & iOS Compatible – Works with most smartphones

Product Details:
Display Size: 1.3-inch Touch Screen
Battery Capacity: 200mAh
Standby Time: Up to 10 Days
Usage Time: 1–3 Days (varies by use)
Connectivity: Bluetooth
Compatibility: Android & iOS
Waterproof Rating: IP67

Benefits:
Stay connected without checking your phone constantly
Manage daily tasks from your wrist
Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear
Ideal for work, travel, and everyday use

What’s in the Box:
1 × GT1 Smartwatch
1 × Charging Cable
1 × User Manual

Special Note:
Battery timing may vary depending on usage
Not suitable for swimming or hot showers
Charge fully before first use
High-quality smart wearable for daily use
